messages.author: 722521532a54784f
messages.subject: Report heterozygosity - outliers list
parts:
Hi everyone,
I just have a question on the gl.report.heterozygosity function, when used with the "ind" method.

A list of outliers is also provided. I am just wondering how the outliers are computed?

Thanks a lot
Best,
Gabriella

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: Report heterozygosity - outliers list
parts:
Hi Gabriella,

The output of gl.report.heterozygosity using the "ind" method is a list of observed heterozygosities of all the individuals in the dataset ordered from low to high heterozygosity.

Heterozygosity by individual is reported using a Boxplot and a histogram. You can read how outliers are computed in a boxplot in the link below:
https://www.simplypsychology.org/boxplots.html

Cheers,
Luis
